name: pcs-meeting-notes-creator
description: Personalized automated meeting notes for anyone at PCS. A guided setup wizard (/setup-meeting-reports) interviews the user — how many connectors and how much access they want (Minimal: Claude work only; Standard: + Gmail sent-mail + Google Drive activity; Full: + Jira + Google Chat) — walks them through connecting each source with THEIR OWN accounts, lets them define their recurring meetings and exact reporting windows, then creates scheduled tasks that generate a comprehensive Detailed report and a one-page bullet Quickfire report (.docx) before each meeting, summarizing THE USER'S OWN work across every enabled source. Reports deliver to the user's Google Drive (Work Summaries/<year>/<week range>/) with a local-folder backup. Google Chat requires a one-time OAuth setup — the wizard warns it is more involved, explains the process, and asks before proceeding. Privacy built-ins: reports cover only the user's own work, personal chat spaces/threads are excluded via a user-defined exclusion list, all sources are read strictly read-only, no messages are ever sent, and old reports are never modified. Bundles a strictly read-only Google Chat puller script (owner-approved exception to the markdown-only rule). Includes /run-meeting-report for on-demand runs.
